description: What the app's comment-writing test reads from GitHub and writes there, recorded from the app with writes and the comments fixture's git: rozed-dev/e2e#94, opened on its diff; c on line 2 of src/backoff.ts, a comment typed, and ⌘⏎, which started rozed-bot's pending review with it as a thread; the threads and the pending review read again after; then ⌘⏎ again, a summary typed and ⌘⏎, which submitted the review as a comment, the only verdict GitHub takes from the pull request's author; what was read again after that, and the polls repeated while it stayed open.
